description: This file is a PHP source code for managing test projects within the TestLink open source test management system. It includes functions for creating, editing, deleting, and updating test projects, as well as initializing page variables and handling form input. The file orchestrates the web interface logic for managing test projects, including rendering templates and handling user actions.

classes.name: testproject
classes.description: A class likely representing the test project manager, used for database interactions related to test projects.

classes.name: tlIssueTracker
classes.description: A class managing issue tracker linkage and operations for test projects.

classes.name: tlCodeTracker
classes.description: A class managing code tracker linkage and operations for test projects.

classes.name: tlReqMgrSystem
classes.description: A class managing requirements management system linkage for test projects.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: A class representing user roles and rights within the system.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a test project record by its ID.

methods.name: get_by_name
methods.description: Retrieves a test project record by its name.

methods.name: get_by_prefix
methods.description: Retrieves a test project record by its prefix.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new test project record.

methods.name: get_all
methods.description: Returns all test projects, possibly with filters.

methods.name: checkName
methods.description: Checks if a test project name is valid and not a duplicate.

methods.name: get_accessible_for_user
methods.description: Retrieves test projects accessible for a specific user.

methods.description: Activates or deactivates a test project.

methods.name: disableIssueTracker
